text: Best in-home sales job I've had. Commission is straightforward: half pays on the next 1st or 15th and the rest at install, so the money comes fast. Hit the monthly number and you get a bonus on the whole month, back to day one. The price sheet is clear, the walk-in showers and tub conversions are good quality, and most of the people I meet really need the work, often older folks who can't safely use their tub anymore. The owner is easy to work with and will listen if a deal needs some flexibility. Nobody micromanages, and you run your own follow-ups and schedule. If you're self-driven and like getting paid for effort, this is a great place
